9SOAH DOCKET NUMBER 473-26-16349

APPLICATION OF ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC FOR A CERTIFICATE OF CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY EAST TO BIG HILL 765 kV TRANSMISSION LINE
DIRECT TESTIMONY OF LOREN & CHARLES POWELL ON BEHALF OF THEMSELVES
Loren and Charles Powell
For Oran Creek Ranch, LLC
I filed the Direct Testimony and Exhibits of Loren and Charles Powell on June 2, 2026 to the SOAH Docket Number 473-26-16349 on the Kiteworks and a copy of the Exhibits on site PUC interchange filing site number 5367.
I did not receive an invitation from ONCR’S Egnyte site by 5:00 PM as stated in the documents and therefore could not upload the Direct Testimony and Exhibits to be considered as evidence. 
Why did I not receive and email with an invitation?  We respectfully request that we be given an opportunity to submit our Testimony and Exhibits into evidence to ONCOR.
Loren and Charles Powell
Oran Creek Ranch, LLC
